text:
Olivia Chen: Quick heads-up — starting the EU change window in ~10m to roll a routing tweak for model X (canary). Preflight metrics looked fine but want a couple of eyeballs on SLO dashboards before we progress. deploy-bot: preflight checks (links below) — all green except a transient embed p95 anomaly in eu-west-1 at T-8m. https://dash.re/teams/eng-platform/preflight/1759009876

deploy-bot: Preflight summary: 
- kernel health: ok
- kvcache: ok
- p95 embed (eu-west-1): 280ms spike at 2m, returned to baseline
- 5xx rate: 0.03% over 1h

Henry Gomez: looking now — I can see that 280ms hump, it aligns with a small autoscaler bump + cold-start churn. traces show a handful of replica warmups.

Priya Patel: I caught 3 x 502s in eu-west cluster during that window, envoy upstream timeout. tailing logs: "upstream request timeout after 15s". attaching trace link: https://traces.re/trace/xyz123

Nate Ortiz: canary plan is to start at 10% for 12m, then 30% if stable. should we pin the model version to X.Y.Z for the canary nodes or let routing use variant fallback?

Olivia Chen: pin to X.Y.Z for now — we want deterministic behavior for the experiment. Do NOT bump beyond 10% if 5xx > 0.5% or p95 > 350ms in the first 5m.

Sara Liu: running a few synthetic curl checks from eu-west sim nodes — responses look normal, latencies ~90-120ms. command: 
```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.eu-west.re/generate | jq '.latency'
```

Henry Gomez: if the cold-start is the driver, we can lower the concurrency from 16 -> 8 on the canary pool to reduce autoscaler jitter. applying small patch now: 
```
# k8s patch (canary pool)
spec: \n  containers:\n    - name: infer
      resources:
        limits:
          cpu: "4"
        requests:\n          cpu: "2"\n  env:\n    - name: RW_CONCURRENCY
      value: "8"
```

Priya Patel: ack, I'll keep an eye on envoy timeouts and raise an alert if 5xx crosses 0.5% for a sustained 2m. Pinged @oncall.

oncall-bot: Noted — on-call has been paged for SLO watch. Pager policy: SLO-breach -> page after 1m of threshold breach. Rollback template: if >1% 5xx sustained 3m OR p95 > 500ms sustained 3m, rollback to previous stable routing and open incident.

Nate Ortiz: canary started at 10% now (2026-03-21T15:12Z). Deploy-bot posted traffic split and sample logs: https://deploy.re/canary/1759009876

Olivia Chen: holding at 10% for 12m. Everyone stand by to call rollback if thresholds hit. Thanks for the quick checks — will update after the 6m snapshot. :thumbsup:
